# ZipFile creation fails with Python versions before 3.8

I'm trying to use python-pptx with Python 3.7 and I'm getting an error when saving presentations.

## Steps to reproduce

```python
from pptx import Presentation

prs = Presentation()
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[0])
title = slide.shapes.title
title.text = "Hello, World!"
prs.save("test.pptx")  # This fails
```

## Error message

```
TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'strict_timestamps'
```

## Environment

- Python 3.7.9
- python-pptx 0.6.23

## Expected behavior

The presentation should save without errors.

## Actual behavior

The code fails with a TypeError about an unexpected keyword argument 'strict_timestamps'.

After investigating, I found that the `strict_timestamps` parameter was added to `zipfile.ZipFile` in Python 3.8, but python-pptx is trying to use it even on older Python versions.

This seems to be a regression, as older versions of python-pptx worked fine with Python 3.7.
